Name: Taco Trellis
Author: miphasgrace2
Description:
CRUNCH! Eat 'em or Sell 'em, Give 'em away!

Half the tacos are Vegetable category, half are Fruit category.


Now with approximately 11 taco crop varieties to the lineup! PLUS! A VERY SPECIAL SURPRISE TACO. Do you have the Earth, Fire, Wind, Water and Heart (tacos) to make it? 


The Special Taco (the in game name is different but you can't miss it) is a Recipe! You can buy it from Gus. Pricey? Sure. But this special taco comes with BUFFS! (Warning: may be OP. Please let me know if you get yourself stuck so I can adjust.)
